_comment: Chrome DevTools MCP, pointed at the OPERATOR'S already-logged-in Chrome via --browser-url (DR-035). Start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222 FIRST (see README), then launch Claude Code here. Attaching to the operator's session (not a fresh browser) is what reuses existing GitHub cookies so OAuth/sudo/2FA need no credential handling. The browser surface is fenced by the check-bootstrap-url-allowlist.sh PreToolUse hook (settings.json).
